# Count Pairs That Form a Complete Day I.

@example 10 + 14 = 24, 10 + 38 = 48, 14 + 34 = 48 and 38 + 34 = 72; 5 makes a complete day with no other job.
[10,14,38,5,34]
=> 4

@example 36, 60 and 84 are each 12 hours past a whole day, so any two of them make a complete day (3 pairs); 9 makes one with 15 and with 39 (24 and 48), but 15 + 39 = 54 does not.
[36,9,60,15,84,39]
=> 5

@example Every pair adds up to 40 hours, which is not a whole number of days.
[20,20,20]
=> 0

# A single job, even a whole day long, has no partner.
[24]
=> 0

# A lone 12 is not paired with itself.
[12]
=> 0

# Two 12s make one pair.
[12,12]
=> 1

# Remainders 3 and 21 complete each other; the pair counts once.
[3,21]
=> 1

# The largest multiple of 24 allowed, with another multiple of 24.
[999999984,24]
=> 1

# 10^9 is 16 hours past a whole number of days: 8 and 32 complete it.
[1000000000,8,32]
=> 2

# The largest possible sum, 2 * 10^9, is 8 hours past a whole day.
[1000000000,1000000000]
=> 0

# All remainders are 1: no sum is a multiple of 24.
[1,25,49,73]
=> 0

# Three jobs of remainder 6 and two of remainder 18: 3 * 2 pairs.
[6,18,6,18,30]
=> 6

# Remainder 0 (three jobs, 3 pairs) and remainder 12 (two jobs, 1 pair).
[24,12,48,36,72,1]
=> 4

# 100 multiples of 24: every one of the 4950 pairs counts, more than a
# byte-sized counter holds.
[24,48,72,96,120,144,168,192,216,240,264,288,312,336,360,384,408,432,456,480,504,528,552,576,600,624,648,672,696,720,744,768,792,816,840,864,888,912,936,960,984,1008,1032,1056,1080,1104,1128,1152,1176,1200,1224,1248,1272,1296,1320,1344,1368,1392,1416,1440,1464,1488,1512,1536,1560,1584,1608,1632,1656,1680,1704,1728,1752,1776,1800,1824,1848,1872,1896,1920,1944,1968,1992,2016,2040,2064,2088,2112,2136,2160,2184,2208,2232,2256,2280,2304,2328,2352,2376,2400]
=> 4950

# 50 jobs of remainder 5 and 50 of remainder 19: 50 * 50 pairs.
[29,19,101,187,173,355,245,523,317,691,389,859,461,1027,533,1195,605,163,677,331,749,499,821,667,893,835,965,1003,1037,1171,1109,139,1181,307,1253,475,1325,643,1397,811,1469,979,1541,1147,1613,115,1685,283,1757,451,1829,619,1901,787,1973,955,2045,1123,2117,91,2189,259,2261,427,2333,595,2405,763,2477,931,2549,1099,2621,67,2693,235,2765,403,2837,571,2909,739,2981,907,3053,1075,3125,43,3197,211,3269,379,3341,547,3413,715,3485,883,3557,1051]
=> 2500
